Asked for the best dispensary near Galena, ChatGPT named Verilife, nuEra, The Dispensary and Botanicanna. ChatGPT itself notes Botanicanna is not a licensed recreational marijuana dispensary. Bridge City, about 12 miles from Galena, was not mentioned.

Why it happens

AI builds its answers from trusted sources around the web, not just your website.

09
MissingScreenshot

Galena's tourism site lists nuEra and Verilife, not Bridge City

Galena Country, the official tourism site for Jo Daviess County, has listings for nuEra and Verilife, and features Verilife in its trip guides. A search of the site for "bridge city" returns nothing. ChatGPT uses this site: nuEra's photo in ChatGPT's answers comes from its Galena Country listing.

10
Wrong informationScreenshot

Your Yelp listing says 3.0 stars and closed Sundays

Your Yelp listing is claimed and was updated a week ago, but it shows 3.0 stars from 6 reviews and lists you as closed on Sundays. Your website and Google both say you are open 7 days. The 3.0 on Yelp matches the 3.0 ChatGPT shows.

How we checked. Every answer here is real and was captured on November 12, 2026. AI answers change from one run to the next, so the order can shift. This report covers the answers where Bridge City was not the recommendation or was left out.
